pages.text: $(l)Worn$(): max health $(l)+4$(). Putting it on does not heal you.$(br2)$(l)Enshrined$(): believers within 48 blocks of the temple, meaning the villagers and residents of Greek villages, get $(l)+40%%$() max health. Vanilla villagers also cannot be turned into zombie villagers.
Found in the vault behind the $(l)abandoned temple$(), like Rheia's Crown.

Pygmalion, a sculptor of Cyprus, carved a girl out of ivory so lifelike that he fell in love with it. At the festival of Venus he prayed at the altar for a wife like his statue. When he went home and touched it, the ivory grew soft and warm.$(br2)(Ovid, Metamorphoses, book 10)
